predictions.reason: Source implements SHORT structure with serial checks (lines 11-14) and tool acquired after empty_0 wait/clear (lines 9-15), matching the SPEC's required_order. However, the producer's first iteration (i=0) signals ready_0 (line 23) before the consumer's first iteration (i=0) can signal empty_0 (line 39), which the consumer needs before the producer's second iteration (i=1) can proceed (line 9). The consumer's first iteration waits ready_0 (line 29), but the producer's first iteration acquires buffer_lock (line 18) and places part_0 at buffer_0 (line 20) before the consumer can pick it up. The consumer then acquires buffer_lock (line 30) and picks part_0 from buffer_0 (line 32). The producer's second iteration (i=1) waits empty_0 (line 9), which is signaled by the consumer's first iteration (i=0, line 39). This creates a correct dependency chain. But the producer's second iteration acquires buffer_lock (line 18) and places part_1 at buffer_1 (line 20), while the consumer's second iteration (i=1) waits ready_1 (line 29) then acquires buffer_lock (line 30) and picks part_1 from buffer_1 (line 32). The buffer_0 and buffer_1 are the same physical capacity-one buffer (per SPEC), so the producer's second placement at buffer_1 (line 20) occurs while the consumer's first pickup from buffer_0 (line 32) may still be in progress or the buffer may still be occupied. The producer waits empty_0 (line 9) which is signaled after the consumer's first pickup and departure (line 39), so the buffer should be empty. However, the consumer's first iteration signals empty_0 (line 39) after releasing buffer_lock (line 37), and the producer's second iteration waits empty_0 (line 9) before acquiring buffer_lock (line 18). This seems correct. The terminal poses are left_home and right_home (lines 47-48), matching goals. Events ready_0, ready_1 are cleared by consumer (line 34), empty_0 is cleared by producer (line 10). Resources tool and buffer_lock are released (lines 22, 26, 37). The main issue is that the producer's first iteration (i=0) does not wait for empty_0, but the SPEC only requires waiting empty_0 for the second item (line 9, i==1). The SPEC states 'Producer waits and clears empty_0 before entering buffer with the second part.' This is satisfied. The code appears to implement the TASK_GOAL correctly, but the SHORT dependency structure requires tool acquire after second-item wait and checks (lines 9-15), which is satisfied. The terminal state, empty hands, resources OFF, events cleared, and deadline all appear satisfied. Label C.
